body:
Still reproducible on `v4.5.dev.custom_build [215acd52e]`. From a quick debug, it looks like the issue may be related to the fact that lines in the script editor seem to be internally zero-indexed, while line numbers passed to external editors are typically one-indexed, since when I put a breakpoint in `ScriptEditor::edit` I can see `p_line` is the line number before the breakpoint. Unsure why this would only show up in this place though and not everywhere an external editor is opened, since there doesn't seem to be any handling for this in this function, unless there is handling further up the call stack in other places.

```
Godot v4.5.dev (215acd52e) - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)
```

cc @AThousandShips
